description: This file is a PHP class definition for 'Loader' within the OpenCart framework, responsible for dynamically loading models, controllers, libraries, configs, helpers, language files, and views, and handling method calls within the system engine.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A class for dynamically loading models, controllers, libraries, configs, helpers, language files, and views in the OpenCart system engine, with methods supporting overloading and event triggering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Loader object with a Registry instance.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Overloads property access to retrieve components from the registry.

methods.name: controller
methods.description: Loads and executes a controller action based on a route and arguments, triggering pre- and post-execution events.

methods.name: model
methods.description: Loads a model class, initializes it if not already loaded, and invokes the specified method, with event triggering.

methods.name: library
methods.description: Loads a library class, initializes it if not already loaded, and returns it, with event triggering.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Loads configuration settings based on a route, with event triggering.

methods.name: helper
methods.description: Includes helper PHP files from the system or extension directories, with event triggering.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Loads a view template, passes data, and renders the output, triggering events before and after.

methods.name: language
methods.description: Loads language files and returns language data arrays, with event integration.
